_comment: Dynamic routes that hand OTel host telemetry to the OpenTelemetry Host Monitoring extension's pipelines. pipelineCustomId is resolved to the tenant-specific settings objectId at apply time (see apply-routes.py). Order matters only relative to existing routes: logs/spans routes are APPENDED so specialised routes (e.g. the Claude Code GenAI route) keep priority.

entry.description: OpenTelemetry host/process metrics (host.id) -> OpenTelemetry Host Monitoring extension pipeline (creates OTEL_HOST / OTEL_PROCESS in Smartscape)
OpenTelemetry logs with host identity -> OpenTelemetry Host Monitoring extension pipeline (links records to OTEL_HOST). Appended last: specialised routes above keep priority.
OpenTelemetry spans with host identity -> OpenTelemetry Host Monitoring extension pipeline (links spans to OTEL_HOST, service runs_on edge). Appended last: Claude Code GenAI route keeps priority.
